title: dedicated-fleet-autoscaler-priority-routing-burst-util-reporting
author: Aisha Patel
description: Adds priority-based routing and improved burst control telemetry to the dedicated fleet autoscaler. Motivation: customers running mixed SLAs on a shared dedicated fleet need predictable throughput guarantees for high-priority tenants while allowing lower-priority workloads to burst without jeopardizing SLA-bound traffic. This PR implements a priority routing policy in the autoscaler that respects per-tenant throughput guarantees and token-bucket burst allowances, exposes utilization and burst metrics for scheduling decisions, and adds a rollout plan to enable feature flags per-deployment. Key changes: 1) autoscaler: introduce PriorityPolicy that takes per-tenant min_guarantee, max_capacity and burst_token_bucket parameters and schedules nodes accordingly; 2) routing: add a priority-aware request router that annotates requests with priority and preferred model variants; 3) metrics: emit new Prometheus metrics (fleet_priority_utilization, tenant_burst_tokens, autoscaler_rebalance_events) and update per-route dashboards; 4) reporting: enhance utilization report to include per-priority histograms, burst token consumption over time, and RCA hints for sustained contention; 5) migration: scripts to backfill historical utilization and a safe default to disable priority routing until opt-in. Testing: unit tests for policy logic, integration tests with a synthetic mixed-SLA workload, load tests with 500 tenants (varied priorities) showing <2% tail latency increase for priority traffic and improved fairness metrics. Rollout: feature-flag gated and staged by region; default off for existing clusters. Related work: builds on ENG-3124 tokenbucket refactor and complements pr-761234 dedicated-fleet-autoscaler-burst-util-reporting-refactor.
